title: CELLSTYLEMAP typed adapter retention and explicit graph refusal
mode: source audit plus generated adapter capture and export-preflight tests

authoritativeReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeReferences.finding: CELLSTYLEMAP is a distinct object carrying custom TABLESTYLE cell definitions; it is not covered by the TABLESTYLE row-style carrier alone.

authoritativeReferences.title: libdxfrw DRW_Interface callback and DWG object dispatch
authoritativeReferences.finding: The DWG reader already parsed AcDbCellStyleMap and invoked addCellStyleMap, while dx_iface previously relied on the interface's default no-op callback.

researchConclusion.resolved: The concrete dwg2dxf adapter now retains the typed CELLSTYLEMAP callback under aggregate record, item, and byte limits and export preflight rejects a failed capture explicitly.
researchConclusion.unresolved: No qualified DXF object-graph serializer or verified owner/root closure exists for custom CELLSTYLEMAP data, so any successfully captured map remains fail-closed before output publication.

changes: Added adapter-owned typed CELLSTYLEMAP storage and sticky capture accounting in dx_data.
Added a bounded estimator covering table-entry metadata, custom cell-style records, border vectors, CMC names/book names, content format strings, subrecord ranges, and container overhead.
Added dx_iface::addCellStyleMap with 100000-record, 4000000-item, and DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes aggregate limits.
Added prepublication refusal for incomplete CELLSTYLEMAP capture and for any captured CELLSTYLEMAP lacking a qualified DXF graph serializer.
Added generated tests for nested retention/accounting, exact byte-cap admission, byte/record/item rejection, explicit diagnostics, and no-output refusal.

validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check scoped to the plan, adapter, and test files

remainingLocalWork: Research and implement a versioned CELLSTYLEMAP DXF object-graph serializer only after establishing the owner/root relation and custom cell-style payload mapping; otherwise retain the explicit fail-closed gate.
remainingExternalQualification: Native FreeCAD Linux and Windows route qualification
